message:
[CENTER]


[FONT=Arial]
[COLOR=#00b359][SIZE=6][B]Update 1.15 release:[/B][/SIZE][/COLOR][/FONT][/CENTER]

[CENTER][B][SIZE=5]MD-series tandem rear suspension, sleeper cab, auxiliary add-on, and more! For further info check the Updates tab



[/SIZE][/B][/CENTER]
[HR][/HR]


This is a pack of parts, meaning all the parts are as universally compatible and as possible, but most parts are also used in the included configs. Here is a full list of the added parts:

[B]D-series[/B]
- D55 heavy duty truck with it's own frames, engine, suspensions, body panels, and upfits
- 6 door cab and parts
- Extra cab and parts
- 6x6 parts in two bed lengths
- Highly customizable auxiliary support add-on for all frame options
- Tiny Bed and parts
- 'Goliath' off-road suspension and parts, including portal axle hubs, rear steer axles, and 6x6 compatibility
- Extended-, crew-, extra- and 6 Door upfit frames
- Heavy duty flatbed upfit in 2 lengths, featuring ramps, side rails, a front over-cab frame, and more [I](Ramps are operated with a button on the ramps themselfs, and hydraulic controls on the side below the deck)[/I]
- Tanker upfit from the MD-series
- Fifth wheel upfit (for D55 short upfit frames)
- Trailer frames in all lengths, including 3 types of front hitches
- 9.2L V12 engine with turbo or supercharger
- 7.1L i6 turbo diesel engine for the D55
- 5 Transmissions and needed shifters
- 2 transfer cases
- Customizable roll-cages
- Highly customizable exterior roll cages
- 15 Custom Skins
- Interior colors: dark blue, dark brown, green and pink
- Widened fender flares in black and body color
- Flatbeds for long bed and tiny bed frames
- Dually Flatbed (long bed only)
- Heavily cut front fenders
- Heavily cut rear straight quarter panels for off-road frames
- Same cut quarter panels plus wide quarter panels for regular frames in the sizes short bed, long bed, and 6x6 bed
- Customizable race dashboard in 3 materials, and fitting door panels
- Off-road race seats and rear race seats
- Exhaust stacks
- Spotlights with cage
- Customizable Tube doors
- Gooseneck hitch option for flatbeds
- Unobstructive spoiler, compatible with other bed accessories
- Sport bar and outside rear facing seats for all bed options
- Single early and late seats
- Front Guard as bumper attachment
- Reverse portal 5-lug hubs (lowers the car)
- Rear zeta bumper as bumper attachment and front zeta bumper as standalone bumper
- Rear Tube Off-road bumper
- Customizable rear mounted radiator
- Cab handles
- 15 new factory colors
- interior fuel cell
- Roof rack and roof lights at once
- Moveable front off-road independent suspension (moves forward with tuning slider)
- Bumper spacers (gives any bumper tuning sliders to move it's placement)
- Dually fenders with fender flares
- Mudflaps for regular and dually fenders
- Long rollback upfit
- Double and triple nitrous bottles
- trailer front tongue hitch as front bumper or bumper accessory
- Black Bed Covers
- Customizable big roof rack
- Windshield without mirror
- limited angle steering option for independent front suspension
[B]MD-series[/B]
- Tandem rear suspension, with all 3 spring stiffness options and both ride heights, as well as off-road springs and an off-road - lifted version
- Liftaxle compatible with both tandem and single rear suspension
- Sleeper cabs with both long and short sleeper, and fitting front frames for them
- High roof single cab, compatible with the sleeper cabs
- Auxiliary support add-on, which is made from scratch to better fit trucking and heavy haul applications, with options for side toolboxes, rear fuel tanks, air tank mounts, a headache rack, and snorkels, and the ability to change the frame length added with a slider in the tuning menu
- Heavy duty air compressor, meant to go with liftaxle configs
- XL rear frame, allowing for the T-series 26ft box and flatbed upfits, and special celebration skin for the box upfit
- Rollback upfit for the long frame, taken from the T-series and shortened to be about 3/4 the length
- Side fuel tanks, in all 3 lengths and movable along the frame
- Hydraulic steering for off-road front suspension
- Multiple new color options for the late grille, headlight bezels on both front ends, and factory bumper (black, matte black, chrome)
- Alternative customizable roll-cages
- Customizable exterior roll cage
- Configurable off-road leaf springs
- Single and Double snorkels
- Factory single seats
- Super singles
- Off-road and sport tires for the super singles
- Wide Fender flares front and rear
- Interior colors: dark blue, dark brown, green and pink
- 8-speed 'dual' overdrive and direct-drive manual transmissions and shifter
- 6-speed 'single' sport and race manual transmissions and shifter
- 7-speed late automatic transmission for the MD-series
- T400, T570 race, and T750 race turbochargers
- Extreme race internals, and a 4200rpm governor
- Short 4WD transfercase, which mounts higher and further forward to allow for more ground clearance and shorter rear driveshafts
- 3 new longer fifthwheel rear frame endings to allow for more axles and fuel tanks to fit
- Fifthwheel attach helper for off-road ride heights
- Single center roof halogen beacon lights (amber, red, blue)
- Cut rear bumper for the flatbed (the one on "long rear frame")
- Mudflaps that move with the suspension
- Fixed length rear driveshafts (because the moved axles mess the old ones up)
- Long rear fenders for the tanker upfit
- Long front left side step
- New factory colors
- Alternative customizable roll-cages
- Customizable exterior roll cage
- Cab handles
- Windshield without mirror
[B]H-series[/B]
- Long upfit frame
- Long rollback upfit
- Heavy duty flatbed upfit in 2 lenghts, featuring ramps, side rails, a front over-cab frame, and more [I](Ramps are operated with a button on the ramps themselfs, and hydraulic controls on the side below the deck, which is currently incompatible with some other mods)[/I]
- Tanker upfit from the MD-series
- New factory colors
[B]Roamer[/B]
- 'Goliath' off-road suspension and parts, including portal axle hubs and rear steer axles
- Reverse portal 5-lug hubs (lowers the car)
- Moveable front off-road independent front suspension (moves it forward with a tuning slider)
- New factory colors
- limited angle steering option for independent front suspension
[B]General[/B]
- 'Goliath' 20x11 and 20x13 off-road steel 8-lug and 6-lug wheels in 4 colors
- Okudai PR02 20x11 and 20x13 6-lug wheels in 3 colors
- 14 types of 'Goliath' off-road 20x11 and 20x13 tires
- 6 types of off-road 17x9 tires
- 7 types of off-road 16x7 single and dually tires
- 4 types of MD-series 8-lug wheels for regular heavy duty 8-lug hubs, including vanilla truck tires, 9 sets of off-road tires and a set of sport tires


[B]
There are currently 153 configs included, mainly for the D-series and MD-series, but also for the H-series and Roamer![/B]

[SIZE=5][B]Lore:[/B][/SIZE]
[B]D55[/B]
As Gavril made the D-series, they also made the D55. It was offered with only one engine, the 7.1L i6 diesel, making 193 - 293 hp and 508 - 720 Nm of torque depending on the model year and offered air supply to it's air brakes, pintle hitch- and fifth wheel trailers. This truck had major changes in it's chassis compared to the D45 and smaller trucks, which caused it to barely break even financially. Compared to the D45, it was also offered with twin rear axles. They are however somewhat flawed in design, as they have two rear leaf springs independent of each other, commonly causing grip issues which Gavril tried to hide by giving them all locking limited slip interaxle differentials as standard, and cheaply offering low range gearboxes to RWD models.
The tuning company Kentarch also made a rare model of the D55, combining it with their stretched 4 door unibody cab.
[B]Extra cab:[/B]
Gavril offered 4 cab styles on the D-series, one of them being the so called "Extra Cab". It's a stretched single cab with narrow rear windows behind the front doors and features side-facing rear jump seats and an unfolding shelf for added storage. This cab sold well at the 1986 launch of the D-series, but mostly died out by the time the second facelift came arround in 1998, so it's a wonder it lasted until 2003.
